# SD1 adaptation: serialize writes for one project/material and reuse
        # the upstream ledger to reject insufficient source-location stock.
        lock_key = f"sd1_site_inventory:{project_id}:{payload.item_id}"
        await self.session.execute(
            select(func.pg_advisory_xact_lock(func.hashtextextended(lock_key, 0)))
        )
        if payload.movement_type in {"CONSUMPTION", "WASTE", "TRANSFER"}:
            rows = await self._all_movements(project_id)
            source = str(payload.location_id) if payload.location_id is not None else None
            available = ledger.stock_on_hand_by_item_at_location(
                [_to_ledger_movement(row) for row in rows], source
            ).get(str(payload.item_id), _ZERO)
            requested = _to_decimal(payload.quantity)
            if requested > available:
                raise HTTPException(
                    status_code=status.HTTP_409_CONFLICT,
                    detail=f"库存不足：可用 {available}，申请 {requested}。Insufficient stock.",
                )
